facts.fact: ActuNiger reports, and UNICEF's representative repeats, that the INCI solution computerising civil status services was deployed in 103 communes by May 2025, with 40 more being integrated; no total of communes or offices is given, and the large declaration centres are said to have been digitalised.

The 2023-2027 strategic plan for improving civil registration and vital statistics, successor to the 2017-2021 plan evaluated in 2022, was under mid-term review at a workshop opened by the Interior Ministry's secretary general on 7 May 2025; the article presents INCI computerisation as part of the same reform programme.

UNICEF's representative said the computerisation of civil status reached 103 communes notably with UNICEF support, and the WURI-Niger coordinator said WURI aims to computerise 87 more communes by end 2025; the review workshop was to look for lasting financing.
In May 2025, 40 further communes were being integrated into civil status computerisation beyond the 103 covered, and WURI-Niger set a target of 87 additional communes computerised by end 2025.
